format: single JSON object; no code fence; no leading/trailing prose

fields.facts: array of {key:string,value:string,citations:array of exact [K#] markers}; MEMORY facts use no document marker
fields.natural_response: string containing documentary markers as appropriate

parser: strict types, exact fields, no duplicate JSON keys; never infer relation/abstention from substrings
no_evidence_exception: exact UNKNOWN permitted by normative absence guard; maps to facts=[],relation=NO_EVIDENCE,abstain=true,citations=[],natural_response=UNKNOWN
